SELECT qcc.id, qcc.standard_question, qcc.standard_answer, qcc.knowledge_unit_id, qcc.knowledge_group_id, qcc.status, qcc.association_count, qcc.faq_click_count, qcc.exposure_count, qcc.helpful_count, qcc.unhelpful_count, qcc.refusal_count, qcc.recent_questions, qcc.create_user_id, qcc.create_time, qcc.update_user_id, qcc.update_time, qcc.is_deleted, ku.knowledge_unit_name AS knowledge_unit_name FROM kmp_knowledge_question_cluster qcc LEFT JOIN kmp_knowledge_unit ku ON ku.id = qcc.knowledge_unit_id AND ku.is_deleted = 0 WHERE qcc.is_deleted = 0
AND qcc.standard_question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.standardQuestion}, '%')
AND ku.knowledge_unit_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.knowledgeUnitName}, '%')
AND qcc.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY qcc.update_time DESC, qcc.id DESC
